statement: The grid is a list of equal-length strings in which 'X' marks a filled cell and '.' an empty one. Two filled cells belong to the same cluster when they are connected by a chain of filled cells, where consecutive cells are neighbours in any of the 8 directions (horizontal, vertical or diagonal). Return the number of cells in the largest cluster, or 0 if there is no filled cell. The grid is a list of strings that all have the same length; the list may be empty, and its rows may be empty strings.
